descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S20 How long a change takes to reach the other device, ten times per change, both ways, both modes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 A patient added on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh or re-entry. (UAT TC-25 step 2; UAT TC-25; TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U3 A pre-round note dictated and saved on the computer appears on the phone in real time, with no refresh, and can be continued on the phone without re-entering anything. (UAT TC-25 step 3; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 11; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U4 A note generated on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh. (UAT TC-25 step 4; UAT TC-25; TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U5 A patient deleted on the computer disappears from the phone in real time. (UAT TC-25 step 5; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 18; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital. (UAT TC-25 step 6; UAT TC-25; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T2 Edits made on one device (not only add, generate and delete) show on the other in real time, with no refresh. (TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Two contexts with their own sessions on the local stack

When For add, pre-round save, generated note, delete and an edit (Hospital room, Nursing Home Unit / Room), in both directions and both modes, 10 repeats each, each change with its own start and end: add, delete, edit - t0 when A's mutation resolves, t1 when the text shows on B; …

Then Every repeat shows on device B with no reload within 60 s. Pre-round save: the share of repeats at 15 s or less is reported against the 9/10 target, with providerMs alongside (3.5). Generate: any repeat over 30 s where the AI call was not most of the total is flagged for review with Vikram (3.5). Add, delete, edit: p50, p90 and max per cell

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): A repeat that does not show on B within 60 s without a reload counts as 'never shows' and is a Fail. Pre-round save: 9/10 within 15 s is a target, not pass/fail (3.5); t1 is the first panel row, gated on Q5, and the saved text's own t1 is recorded beside it. Generate: total over 30 s with providerMs under half of it is flagged for review, not a Fail. …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from passed to broken.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Adds, edits and deletes show on the other device within a fraction of a second; only the note-generation timing is not measured yet, because Generate is not allowed locally.

Evidence: allure-results/759d3db2…: add / edit / delete reach the other device with p50 54–61 ms (max 162 ms, none over 5 s); pre-round save takes 4.8–8.4 s. Only the Generate cell (40 repeats) did not run, blocked by the same local-Generate permission as S14.

Duplicate: the same issue as TC-25/S14; read that one (the kept one). This result carries the label "Duplicate", so a filter can leave it out.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: probes.

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S20

How long a change takes to reach the other device, ten times per change, both ways, both modes

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress); TFA-94704 Production Web App Hosting + PWA (development backlog)

New local lane probes: status passed-partial in probes/results.json → passed (partly passed (every judged cell passed; part was not run / was mocked)).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: partly): sync-probe timing both modes, both directions: add / edit (room or unit) / delete (Hospital only) × 10 repeats with t0 = writer's mutation resolves, t1 = reader's DOM shows it (no reload); pre-round save and Generate LIVE once per cell (bounded); p50/p90/max per cell, >5 s flagged, aiCallLog durations recorded. [Review 2026-10-14] Labelled passed-partial (Generate cell gated); patch carries partial.needs = ['generate']. — Non-AI cells at the full 10 repeats; AI cells at 1 repeat each to keep live calls bounded (the 9/10 and 30 s are targets, record-only).

Detail:

Partial — 14/14 judged cells pass (every repeat shown on the other device without reload within 60 s), Generate cell NOT RUN. Add / edit (room, unit) / delete (Hospital), 10 repeats per cell, both directions, both modes: p50 54–61 ms, max 162 ms, none over 5 s. Pre-round save (1 repeat per cell, live): first Labs row on the other device after 4.8–8.4 s (≤ 15 s target; record-only). Generate / Regenerate is forbidden on the local target (scripts/capabilities.json, Quinn 2026-10-13); those cells run only with QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1.

Evidence: 2 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — sync-probe with timing (scripted, not written yet): two createAuthSession contexts (local admin key), 180 timed repeats with 40 live Generate presses and 40 Save Note runs, and aiCallLog read with adminQuery; as designed it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
